possible_events_hint: Greyed rows are possible events (unconfirmed nomination or no nomination). They are left out of the report unless you add them with +.
download_message: Click the button below to download your report.
download_expiry: Your download will be available for 24 hours.
email_predefined_notice: This report will be sent to predefined recipients.
email_send_to_self: Also send a copy to me
email_body:
Attached is the timesheet report for %s for month %s.

This email was sent automatically from the Timesheet Filler application.
login_invite_only: Accounts are created by invitation only. Ask an administrator if you need access.
twofa_code_help: 6-digit code from your authenticator app or email, or one of your recovery codes.
email_code_body:
Your sign-in code is %s.

It is valid for 10 minutes. If you did not try to sign in, change your password.
email_code_sent: We sent a code to your email. It is valid for 10 minutes.
enroll_help: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Bitwarden, Google Authenticator, 1Password, …), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
enroll_manual: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
enroll_recovery_help: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe, e.g. in your password manager. Each works once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now.
invite_google_help: Use the Google account with this email address.
invite_password_help: At least 12 characters. A password manager can generate one.
invite_email_body:
You have been invited to Timesheet Filler.

Accept the invitation within 7 days, or open this link: %s
admin_email_disabled: Email is disabled, so hand the invitation link over yourself.
admin_confirm_reset_mfa: Reset two-factor authentication? The user sets it up again at the next sign-in.
auth_err_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
auth_err_invite_invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or already used.
auth_err_no_account: There is no account for this Google login. Ask an administrator for an invitation.
auth_err_email_mismatch: The Google account email does not match the invitation.
auth_err_email_not_verified: The Google account email is not verified.
auth_err_weak_password: The password must have at least 12 characters.
auth_err_user_exists: A user with this email already exists.
auth_err_invalid_email: The email address is not valid.
auth_err_too_soon: A code was sent less than a minute ago.
auth_err_self: You cannot do this to your own account.
auth_err_last_admin: There must be at least one active admin.
auth_err_no_eos_name: Your account is not linked to a coach name yet. Ask an administrator.
